noDevicesBody: Plug in your receiver or a cable. Devices appear here automatically.
experimentalBody: Battery reading for this device comes from Glorious CORE’s protocol but has not been confirmed on real hardware yet. Tell us if it works.
soonBody: DPI, polling rate, lighting and button mapping are next on the roadmap.
startupBody: Launch quietly to the tray when you sign in.
minimizeToTrayBody: Minimizing hides the window; BetterGlorious keeps running next to the clock. Closing always does.
notificationsBody: Show a notification when a device drops below the threshold.
pollBody: How often batteries are read. Devices that push updates refresh instantly.
aboutBody: Battery levels and settings for Glorious mice and keyboards, without Glorious CORE. Open source.
disclaimer: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Glorious LLC. Product names and images belong to their owners.
debounceHint: Lower is faster, higher prevents double clicks
sleepHint: Wireless idle time before the device sleeps
savedOnDevice: Changes are saved on the device
notReadable: Settings appear once the device answers. Move or press something on it to wake it.
saveAndAssign: Save and assign to this button
pollingHint: How often the device reports to the PC
liftOffHint: Height at which tracking stops when you lift the mouse
holdForHint: How long each press is held down
jitterHint: Varies every delay a little so the rhythm looks human
minHoldHint: Shortest time a key stays down; games like Minecraft need ~30 ms
gapAfterHint: Wait at the end before the macro repeats
pickAppHint: Open the game or app first; its window shows up here.
modeOnceHint: Plays the whole macro once per press.
modeHoldHint: Repeats while you hold the button and stops the moment you let go.
modeToggleHint: One press starts repeating, the next press stops it.
modeRepeatHint: Plays the macro the set number of times per press.
keyHoldHint: The key stays down for as long as you hold the mouse button, just like a real key. To press it again and again while holding, use Rapid fire.
autoProfileHint: Switches the mouse to a profile when an app or game comes to the front, e.g. Minecraft → 2, CS2 → 3, everything else → 1. BetterGlorious must be running.
softHint: Played by the PC: unlimited, exact timing, works in games like Minecraft.
onboardHint: Played by the mouse itself, even without BetterGlorious running.
softIntro: Macros are played by BetterGlorious with exact timing and no length limit, like Razer Synapse. Create one (or start from Rapid click), then assign it to a button in Buttons → Macro.
softAssignHint: Assign it to a button in Buttons → Macro.
antiCheat: Some anti-cheat protected games block or flag software input.
noSoftMacros: No macros yet. Create one in the Macros tab.
rapidHint: While you hold the button (or after one press in toggle mode) it keeps pressing with this rhythm. BetterGlorious must be running.
restoreConfirm: Restore every setting to how it was when BetterGlorious first read this device?
rememberedNote: This device can't report its settings, so BetterGlorious shows the last values it sent.
buttonsHint: Click a button to change what it does. Changes are written to the mouse.
noMacros: No macros yet. Create one in the Macros tab.
launchHint: BetterGlorious must be running for this to work; the mouse tells it the button was pressed.
macroAssignHint: Assign it to a button in Buttons
recordHint: Records keys and clicks with their timing
recordingHint: Recording: type, or click in this box
emptyMacro: Add steps with the buttons above.
